environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; complex but rounded radial symmetry; 'frozen-bubble' or fine-porcelain texture; emphasizes the ancient, delicate nature of the pelagic ecosystem.

visual_logic.composition: A high-depth perspective shot showing the radial skeletons of radiolarians drifting like snowflakes in the deep blue Tethys water. The view emphasizes the immense scale of the open ocean shelf.
visual_logic.ground: A flat, abyssal-style floor of soft chalk and marl with scattered ammonite shells.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; dramatic crepuscular rays (god-rays) penetrating the indigo water, highlighting the delicate silhouettes of the floating micro-skeletons.
